title: 1v1 pending invitation restart recovery

behavior.case: restart while a 1v1 invitation is pending, then Accept in a new process
assertions: pending status and revision survive restart
invitation owner/opponent and Deck snapshot survive restart
Accept advances the revision once and clears invite payload
exactly two membership locks are persisted

behavior.case: restart while a 1v1 invitation is pending, then Decline and replay stale Accept
restart before invitation deadline, then expire at exactly 120000 ms
assertions: invitation is pending at deadline minus 1 ms
status becomes expired at exact deadline
no DuelState or transition event is created

isolation.database: Temporary SQLite under OS temp directory
isolation.processes: A separate Node 22 process reopens the same SQLite file

invariants.expected: byte-equivalent row snapshots before and after restart/consent

limitations: Validates persisted store behavior across Node process restart, not a live Discord gateway.
No runtime, handler, catalog, resolver or player-data changes.
